title: CPython tier-2 micro-opcode deoptimization stack spill overwrite
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0364: CPython tier-2 micro-opcode deoptimization stack spill overwrite
Repository: `python/cpython`
Category: `Compiler IR Optimization & SSA Lowering`
Target File: `Python/bytecodes.c`

#### Problem Description
JIT trace deopt handler restores stack pointers using tier-1 frame layout, corrupting local variables.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Align tier-2 deopt stack restore offset with tier-1 frame layout table.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0364.py -q`
expected_invariant: Align tier-2 deopt stack restore offset with tier-1 frame layout table.
